description: Bus stops nearest to a coordinate, each with its heading and the city bus and InterCity coach routes that stop there, nearest first. Pass a stop and route to bus_eta for live arrivals. Example: lat 25.0478, lon 121.517, city "Taipei".

city.description: City the point is in: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, ChiayiCounty, Chiayi, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, ...). InterCity coach stops are always included.

limit.description: Maximum number of stops to return (default 10).

name: bus_stops_nearby
title: Bus stops nearby
